content:
Rumors suggest Apple has been working on major changes to its Home lineup, and a new leak offers a number of products to look forward to.

macOS code leak mentions several unannounced Home devices

Apple's biggest annual reveal event is just weeks away. Multiple new Home products are expected to be unveiled alongside the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone Ultra, new Apple Watch models, and more.

A new Apple TV 4K, HomePod mini 2, and the long-awaited HomePad are rumored to debut. But several other Home products may also be on the horizon.

MacRumors discovered yesterday that the newly released macOS 26.7 RC contains references to several unannounced products.

Among them are codenames related to Home devices. According to Juli Clover:

  • HomePad (J490 and J491): "J490 is believed to be the version with a dock for a home hub, while J491 is the wall-mountable version."
  • HomePod mini 2 (B525): Since the HomePod mini carried the codename B520, this is likely the mini 2.
  • Home Accessory (J229): Likely the rumored security camera product.
  • HomeAccessory17,2 and HomeAccessory17,3: Newly mentioned unknown Home devices.
  • ATVRemote1,5: A new-generation Siri Remote to launch alongside the new Apple TV 4K.

Other Home products reportedly in development include a video doorbell and a desktop robotic-style home hub. It is unclear whether their codenames have appeared in the macOS 26.7 leak.

Beyond products, MacRumors also discovered a reference to "Pebble," believed to be the codename for homeOS. There is also a string "audio_accessory_visual_reasoning" that may be related to the HomePad.

Finally, four colors were found for an unspecified Home accessory: Rose Pink, Silver, Space Gray, and Starlight.
